40200.meaning1: makes amends; fixes; repairs; redresses; remedies; corrects oneself
40200.commentary: (DNa) yathā dhammaṃ paṭikarosī'ti yathā dhammo ṭhito tath'eva karosi, khamāpesī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakass'eva paccāropeti, tvaṃ kho'si itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, tvaṃ tāva paṭhamaṃ paṭikarohī'ti.
yato ca kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi, taṃ te mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma.

40201.meaning1: acts accordingly; does in return; responds accordingly; deals with
40201.commentary: (ANa) yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissatī'ti dhamm'ānurūpaṃ paṭikarissati, sāmaṇerabhūmiyaṃ ṭhassatī'ti attho.

examples.text: assakhaḷuṅko hi, sandha, doṇiyā baddho, yavasaṃ yavasan'ti jhāyati. taṃ kissa hetu? na hi, sandha, assakhaḷuṅkassa doṇiyā baddhassa evaṃ hoti, kiṃ nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kim'ass'āhaṃ paṭikaromī'ti.
tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, anāpanno vā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ na āpajjissati, āpanno vā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissati.

40204.meaning1: (vinaya) draws back; drags back; throws back; sends one back (to the beginning of a legal action)

examples.text: saṅgh'ādiseso'ti saṅgho'va tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ deti, mūlāya paṭikassati, mānattaṃ deti, abbheti, na sambahulā, na ekapuggalo. tena vuccati, saṅgh'ādiseso'ti.

40205.meaning1: (vinaya) sending back (to the beginning of a legal action)

examples.text: sace upajjhāyo mūlāya paṭikassan'āraho hoti, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ, kin'ti nu kho saṅgho upajjhāyaṃ mūlāya paṭikasseyyā'ti.

40206.meaning1: (vinaya) sent one back (to the beginning of a legal action)

examples.text: so'haṃ saṅghaṃ antarā-āpattīnaṃ mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā-āpattīnaṃ mūlāya paṭikassi adhammikena kammena kuppena aṭṭhān'ārahena, adhammena samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi.
seyyathā'pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭikā-atthato paṭalik'atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāno

40209.commentary: (DNa) cirapaṭik'āhaṃ, bhante'ti cirato ahaṃ, cirato paṭṭhāy'āhaṃ dassanakāmo'ti attho.

examples.text: cirapaṭikā-ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu'kāmo, n'atthi ca me kāyasmiṃ tāvatikā balamattā, yāvat'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyan'ti

40212.meaning2: worst; bad; poor; terrible; lit. insulted

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici tant'āvutānaṃ vatthānaṃ, kesakambalo tesaṃ paṭikiṭṭho akkhāyati. kesakambalo, bhikkhave, sīte sīto, uṇhe uṇho, dubbaṇṇo, duggandho, dukkhasamphasso.

40213.meaning2: having covered over, having turned upside down

40214.meaning2: having covered over, having turned upside down

examples.text: atha kho muṇḍo rājā piyakaṃ kos'ārakkhaṃ āmantesi, tena hi, samma piyaka, bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjatha, yathā mayaṃ bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ cirataraṃ passeyyāmā'ti.

40216.meaning2: covering or bending over, turning upside down

examples.text: evaṃ, devā'ti kho piyako kos'ārakkho muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujji.
ayaṃ loko kena āvuto nivuto ovuto, pihito paṭicchanno paṭikujjito'ti, kenassu nivuto loko?

40219.meaning1: having covered over; having enclosed (something with)
40219.meaning2: having covered over, having turned upside down

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā parisuddhā pariyodātā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā ahikuṇapaṃ vā kukkurakuṇapaṃ vā manussakuṇapaṃ vā racayitvā aññissā kaṃsapātiyā paṭikujjitvā antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ.

eten'upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.

40222.meaning2: having covered over, having turned upside down

40224.meaning1: gets angry back; responds angrily; is angry in return

examples.text: tass'eva tena pāpiyo, yo kuddhaṃ paṭikujjhati, kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto, saṅgāmaṃ jeti dujjayaṃ.
imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ macchariyānaṃ etaṃ paṭikuṭṭhaṃ, yadidaṃ dhammamacchariyan'ti.

40228.synonym: akanta, akantiya, aniṭṭha, appiya, amanāpa, amanāpika, amanāpiya, nanikāma, lūkhasa

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ vante puna bhottu'kamyatā assā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante. taṃ kissa hetu? aduñ'hi, bhante, vantaṃ paṭikūlasammatan'ti.
atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo

tam'enaṃ uṭṭhahitvā apāpuritvā olokeyya. tassa sahadassanena amanāpatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, paṭikūlatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jegucchatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jighacchitānam'pi na bhottu'kamyatā assa, pag'eva suhitānaṃ.

40231.meaning1: section on attention to the repulsive

examples.text: paṭikūlamanasikārapabbaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

40232.meaning1: considered to be repulsive; regarded as disagreeable

examples.text: asuci, bho kassapa, gūthakūpo asuci c'eva asucisaṅkhāto ca duggandho ca duggandhasaṅkhāto ca jeguccho ca jegucchasaṅkhāto ca paṭikūlo ca paṭikūlasaṅkhāto cā'ti.

40233.meaning1: perception of repulsiveness; concept of unpleasantness (of)
40233.commentary: (DNa) āhārepaṭikūlasaññā'ti āhāraṃ pariggaṇhantassa uppannasaññā. (SNa) āhāre paṭikūlasaññā'ti odanakummās'ādimhi ajjhoharaṇīye paṭikūlasaññā. (ANt) āhāre paṭikūlasaññā'ti āhāraṃ gaman'ādi-vasena paṭikūlato pariggaṇhantassa uppannasaññā.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
āhāre paṭikūlasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato rasataṇhāya cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.

40234.meaning1: fortified by the perception of repulsiveness (towards)

examples.text: āhāre paṭikūlasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato rasataṇhāya cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.

40235.meaning1: perceiving as disagreeable; considering to be unpleasant
40235.commentary: (ANa) āhāre paṭikūlasaññī'ti navannaṃ pāṭikulyānaṃ vasena kabaḷīkār'āhāre paṭikūlasaññī.

examples.text: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyan'ti paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati
etha, tumhe, bhikkhave, asubh'ānupassino kāye viharatha, āhāre paṭikūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassino'ti.

seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ bhatte puna bhottu'kamyatā assā'ti. no h'etaṃ, bhante. taṃ kissa hetu, aduñ'hi, bhante, bhattaṃ paṭikūlasammatan'ti.

40237.notes: Saddanīti takes this as an independent root kele mamāyane. Some take it as √kīḷ. Edgerton notes under kelāyati, 'probably not connected with Skt. keli, but origin obscure'.

40238.meaning1: knocks to the side; beats back

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye kiṭṭhasambādhe gopālako gāvo rakkheyya. so tā gāvo tato tato daṇḍena ākoṭeyya paṭikoṭeyya sannirundheyya sannivāreyya.

40239.meaning1: smashes back; crushes out of shape
40239.commentary: (SNa) majjhe paharitvā nāmetvā dhārāya vā paharitvā dve'pi dhārā ekato alliyāpento paṭikoṭṭeti nāma. (SNt) paṭikoṭṭetī'ti paṭipaharati. tattha khaṇḍaṃ viya niyyāso.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, satti tiṇhaphalā. atha puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imaṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇissāmi paṭikoṭṭissāmi paṭivaṭṭessāmī'ti.

40240.meaning1: to smash back; to crush out of shape

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, bhabbo nu kho so puriso amuṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇetuṃ paṭikoṭṭetuṃ paṭivaṭṭetun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

40241.meaning2: stepped backwards, gone back or aside

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nigrodhakappo pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisati, sāyaṃ vā nikkhamati aparajju vā kāle
kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī ahosiṃ
kacci te, āvuso channa, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo'ti?

40244.synonym: abbajati, āgacchati, upanivattati, pacceti, punarāgamati, punupeti

examples.text: so eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati eko paṭikkamati eko raho nisīdati eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
idha, bhante, amhākaṃ yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati so āsanāni paññapeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, avakkārapātiṃ upaṭṭhāpeti

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo assadoso.

40246.meaning1: (of illness) is receding; is retreating; is improving

examples.text: kacci te, āvuso channa, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo'ti?

40247.commentary: (ANa) paṭikkamantu bhūtānī'ti sabbe'pi me kataparittāṇā sattā apagacchantu, mā maṃ viheṭhayiṃsū'ti attho.

examples.text: appamāṇo buddho, appamāṇo dhammo, appamāṇo saṅgho, pamāṇavantāni sarīsapāni. ahivicchikā satapadī, uṇṇanābhī sarabū mūsikā, katā me rakkhā katā me parittā, paṭikkamantu bhūtāni.
abhikkama gahapati, abhikkama gahapati, abhikkamanaṃ te seyyo, no paṭikkamanan'ti.
tato nīharitvā bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvibhajitabban'ti paṭikkamanaṃ nīharitvā saṃvibhajitabbaṃ.

40250.meaning1: time when returning; when coming back

40252.meaning2: stepping backwards, going back or aside

examples.text: m'āhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā. kathañ'hi nāma sayaṃ abhikkamanto, sayaṃ paṭikkamanto evaṃ vakkhati, n'atthi attakāro, n'atthi parakāro'ti!
so abhikkamanto paṭikkamanto bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādeti. imassa pana, gahapati, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto kaṃ vipākaṃ paññapetī'ti?

40254.meaning1: causes to go back; makes retreat

40255.commentary: (SNa) mama dānaṃ paṭikkamī'ti yaṃ mama dānaṃ tattha dīyittha, taṃ paṭinivatti

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, paṭhamaṃ dvāraṃ itth'āgārassa adāsiṃ. tattha itth'āgārassa dānaṃ dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami.

40256.meaning2: stepped backwards, went back or aside

examples.text: sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti, yena c'āhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñ'ca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi me tattha cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vā'pi cetaso'ti…

40257.meaning1: should be returned; should be walked back

examples.text: evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te āloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te viloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ, evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ, evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban'ti.

40258.meaning2: having stepped backwards, having gone back or aside
40258.commentary: (VINt) tato tato paṭikkamitvā'ti tato tato kiccato ārammaṇato ca paṭivattitvā. (SNt) paṭikkamitvā ṭhapanavasena apakkamitvā

examples.text: mahāpuriso satiṃ uppaṭṭhapetvā āgacchanto pacchato paṭikkamitvā sattiṃ vivajjesi. atha naṃ iminā ime hatthī nāsitā'ti gaṇhituṃ pakkhandi.
kacci te, āvuso channa, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo'ti?

40260.commentary: (SNa) ito paṭikkammā'ti ito pakkama parivajjaya, mā uparivāte tiṭṭhā'ti vadanti. (SNPa) eko paṭikkammā'ti kāyavivekaṃ sampādento adutiyo nivattitvā.

examples.text: gandho isīnaṃ ciradikkhitānaṃ, kāyā cuto gacchati mālutena, ito paṭikkamma sahassanetta, gandho isīnaṃ asuci devarājā'ti.
piṇḍañ'ca bhikkhu samayena laddhā, eko paṭikkamma raho nisīde, ajjhattacintī na mano bahiddhā, nicchāraye saṅgahit'attabhāvo.

40262.synonym: akanta, akantiya, aniṭṭha, appiya, amanāpa, amanāpika, amanāpiya, nanikāma, lūkhasa
40262.commentary: (MNa) dukkhapaṭikkūlan'ti dukkhassa paṭikūlaṃ, paccanīkasaṇṭhitaṃ dukkhaṃ apatthayamānan'ti attho. (NIDD1a) dukkhappaṭikkūlo'ti dukkhaṃ anicchamāno.

examples.text: paṭikkūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyan'ti

40263.commentary: (MNa) dukkhapaṭikkūlan'ti dukkhassa paṭikūlaṃ, paccanīkasaṇṭhitaṃ dukkhaṃ apatthayamānan'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā, pūrā aṅgārānaṃ vīt'accikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikkūlo.

40265.meaning1: more repulsive; more disagreeable; more unpleasant (than)

examples.text: piyānaṃ kho, nāgita, vipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā, eso tassa nissando. asubhanimitt'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa kho, nāgita, subhanimitte paṭikkūlatā saṇṭhāti, eso tassa nissando.

so evaṃ vicuṇṇitamakkhito taṅ'khaṇaññ'eva antarahita-vaṇṇa-gandha-saṅkhāra-viseso suvānadoṇiyaṃ ṭhitasuvānavamathu viya paramajegucchabhāvaṃ upagacchati. evarūpo'pi samāno cakkhussa āpāthaṃ atītattā ajjhoharitabbo hotī'ti evaṃ paribhogato paṭikkūlatā paccavekkhitabbā.

40268.meaning1: repulsiveness; fact of being disgusting; unpleasantness

40269.meaning1: recognition of unpleasantness; perception of repulsiveness (of)

40270.meaning1: development of the perception of repulsiveness (of)

40271.meaning1: perceiving as disagreeable; considering to be unpleasant

examples.text: gandho isīnaṃ ciradikkhitānaṃ, kāyā cuto gacchatu mālutena, vicitrapupphaṃ surabhiṃ'va mālaṃ, gandhañ'ca etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhāma bhante, na h'ettha devā paṭikkūlasaññino.

40273.meaning1: due to apprehending the repulsive aspect

examples.text: piyānaṃ kho, nāgita, vipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā, eso tassa nissando. asubhanimitt'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa kho, nāgita, subhanimitte paṭikkūlyatā saṇṭhāti, eso tassa nissando.

40276.meaning1: rejects; refuses to accept; dismisses; disdains

examples.text: yo sāsanaṃ arahataṃ, ariyānaṃ dhammajīvinaṃ, paṭikkosati dummedho, diṭṭhiṃ nissāya pāpikaṃ, phalāni kaṭṭhakass'eva, attaghātāya phallati.
yagghe, bhavaṃ jāneyya, samaṇo mahākaccāno brāhmaṇānaṃ mante ek'aṃsena apavadati, paṭikkosatī'ti

40278.meaning1: rejecting; refusing to accept; dismissing; disdaining

examples.text: sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.

40279.meaning1: rejected; refused to accept; dismissed; disdained
40279.commentary: (MNa) na paṭikkosī'ti sāsanassa anulomaṃ viya pasann'ākāraṃ viya vadatī'ti maññamāno na paṭisedheti.

examples.text: satthā tassa kathaṃ sutvā n'eva abhinandi, na paṭikkosi.

40280.meaning1: should be rejected; should be disdained

examples.text: yo hi koci, bhikkhave, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā imaṃ mahācattārīsakaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ garahitabbaṃ paṭikkositabbaṃ maññeyya tassa diṭṭh'eva dhamme dasasahadhammikā vād'ānuvādā gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchanti

sace me tvaṃ, vappa, anuññeyyañ'c'eva anujāneyyāsi, paṭikkositabbañ'ca paṭikkoseyyāsi, yassa ca me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na jāneyyāsi mam'ev'ettha uttari paṭipuccheyyāsi, idaṃ, bhante, kathaṃ, imassa ko attho'ti, siyā no ettha kathāsallāpo'ti.

40281.meaning1: having rejected; having refused to accept; having dismissed; having disdained
40281.meaning2: having blamed, having rejected, having scorned, having reviled

examples.text: piyajātikā hi kho, bhante, ānandasomanassā piyappabhavikā'ti. atha kho so gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ anabhinanditvā paṭikkositvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkāmi.

40282.commentary: (VINa) bhagavatā paṭikkhittan'tiādimhi yaṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya, taṃ nisajjaṃ kappetuṃ paṭikkhittan'ti evaṃ sambandho veditabbo.

examples.text: pubbe mayaṃ, āvuso, sūpam'pi odanam'pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjāma, tena no phāsu hoti. idāni pana, bhagavatā paṭikkhittan'ti kukkuccāyantā na viññāpema, tena no na phāsu hotī'ti.

40283.commentary: (MNa) sīt'odakapaṭikkhitto'ti nigaṇṭhā sattasaññāya sīt'odakaṃ paṭikkhipanti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno sīt'odakapaṭikkhitto uṇh'odakapaṭisevī. so sīt'odakaṃ alabhamāno kālaṅ'kareyya.
tathā hi pana me, bho gotama, sabbe kamm'antā paṭikkhittā, sabbe vohārā samucchinnā'ti. yathā kathaṃ pana te, gahapati, sabbe kamm'antā paṭikkhittā, sabbe vohārā samucchinnā'ti?

40284.meaning2: having rejected, having refused, having opposed

examples.text: sace tvaṃ, ānanda, tathāgataṃ yāceyyāsi, dv'eva te vācā tathāgato paṭikkhipeyya, atha tatiyakaṃ adhivāseyya. tasmā't'ih'ānanda, tuyh'ev'etaṃ dukkaṭaṃ, tuyh'ev'etaṃ aparaddhaṃ.

40291.meaning2: having rejected, having refused, having opposed

40293.commentary: (VINa) paṭikkhepo paññāyatī'ti paṭikkhepo dissati, tañ'ce abhihaṭaṃ so bhikkhu kāyena vā vācāya vā paṭikkhipatī'ti attho.

examples.text: pavārito nāma asanaṃ paññāyati, bhojanaṃ paññāyati, hatthapāse ṭhito abhiharati, paṭikkhepo paññāyati.

40295.commentary: (VAt) paṭikhāditu'kāmo'ti ettha sayaṃ na khāditu'kāmo'pi aññesaṃ khādan'ārahaṃ ṭhapetuṃ labhati.

40296.meaning1: to eat again; to eat later

examples.text: nanu evaṃ, ānanda, mayā paṭigacc'eva akkhātaṃ, sabbeh'eva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo.
tath'eva katapuññam'pi, asmā lokā paraṃ gataṃ, puññāni paṭigaṇhanti, piyaṃ ñātī'va āgataṃ.
accayaṃ desayantīnaṃ, yo ce na paṭigaṇhati, kop'antaro dosagaru, sa veraṃ paṭimuñcatī'ti.
